+def close_bugs(options, packages, message):
+    ubuntu = options.launchpad.distributions["ubuntu"]
+    for bug_num in options.close_bugs:
+        try:
+            bug = options.launchpad.bugs[bug_num]
+        except KeyError:
+            print("Cannot find LP: #%d" % bug_num)
+            continue
+        if bug.duplicate_of is not None:
+            bug = bug.duplicate_of
+
+        closed = False
+        for task in bug.bug_tasks:
+            target = task.target
+            if target == ubuntu or (
+                    getattr(target, "name", None) in packages and
+                    getattr(target, "distribution", None) == ubuntu):
+                if task.status != "Fix Released":
+                    task.status = "Fix Released"
+                    task.lp_save()
+                    print("Closed LP: #%d (%s)" % (bug_num, task.web_link))
+                else:
+                    print("LP: #%d (%s) already closed" %
+                          (bug_num, task.web_link))
+                bug.newMessage(content=message)
+                closed = True
+                break
+        if not closed:
+            print("Cannot find any tasks on LP: #%d to close." % bug_num)
+
